question: Does applying the actual scored-row mask to the shared main and configured auxiliary head objectives improve official weighted Pearson over all-valid head fitting on the same frozen fold parent?

arms.fit_rows: all fitting-side valid components; valid warmup/padding remains excluded by canonical target validity

arms.objective_scope: main wMSE and configured next/struct auxiliary terms use the canonical main_valid weights

fit.inherited_targets_and_preprocessing: bind exact per-parent hashes before admission; unchanged within each pair
fit.mask_weight_objective_scope: mask_weight changes main_valid for main wMSE and for configured next/struct auxiliary losses. These auxiliary outputs are part of the shared trainable head and remain enabled at 0.3/0.3 to preserve parent checkpoint shape; this is not a main-loss-only estimand.
fit.historical_parent_precision: preserve provenance; no end-to-end FP32-history claim
fit.pre_admission_parameter_audit: only head parameters trainable; inp/gru tensors and input/preprocessing identities unchanged

profile.required_evidence: trainer-process B300 UUID, driver, CUDA runtime, strict-FP32 flags, peak allocated/reserved, and free/total CUDA memory

primary.coverage: all held-out components in F0 and F2
primary.aggregation: equal-cell mean of F0 and F2 treatment-minus-control deltas

uncertainty.method: paired component bootstrap conditional on fixed predictions
uncertainty.pairing: same component multiplicities for control and treatment
uncertainty.fold_rng: independent fold substreams from master seed

secondary.deltas: each blend vs unchanged parent and treatment-blend vs control-blend

metrics.exposure: all folds previously exposed; 2 cells confound parent, fold, and fitting seed

admission.historical_parent_precision_eligibility: exact pinned historical FP16 parents are eligible for this head-only FP32 diagnostic; preserve unknown or mixed ancestry and make no end-to-end FP32 claim
admission.snapshot_semantics: execution_authorized and artifact/profile flags describe this delivery snapshot; they are not runtime permission gates. Explicit receiver commands run only after operator supplies exact assets and profile receipt.
blockers: Supply receiver-side F0/F2 model_ep3.pt checkpoints, provenance, canonical split manifests, and the data/cache files required by canonical split, fit, and scoring guards; exact pinned hashes must match
Run a treatment-shaped canonical profile on the target B300 for each parent width; persist trainer-process UUID/driver/strict-FP32 evidence and confirm at least 10% memory headroom before fitting
Run prefit and post-fit receipts on the same B300; confirm only output-head parameters are trainable and every non-head tensor and preprocessing identity is unchanged
Run the four fits and six common-FP32 held-out predictions, then record the complete source-pinned score report
